not_closed: RI-CMB07 M2 is Mode B FREE PLAY against real AI. This build has no enemy AI (RI-AI01..07 / W1-12), so the enemy runs a declared action schedule while the player bot is free-running. Reported as mode B-prime; M2 remains PARTIAL, not passed.

Exemplar rows 4 (whiff 0.375), 11 (i-frame negation 0.111) and 27 (punish usage 0.163) are still out of band. Cause measured, not guessed: a LIGHT roll is 5.20 m against an enemy whose swing reaches ~2.0 m, so a roll that is TIMED correctly is usually also SPATIAL — the swing misses instead of being negated. The negation band and the roll ladder are in tension and one of them has to move.

No stagger occurs in the median exemplar fight. Player poise health is 48 and the champion's 32 poise damage is 24.5 after resist, so two hits inside the 90 f poise-regen delay are required and the bot's hits are spread out. The stagger LENGTHS are measured directly instead (cmb-poise.mjs: medium 44 f, heavy 64 f).
RI-CMB05 M4 (hyperarmour) inconclusive: the fixture failed to land the control hit outside the window.
The riposte after a successful parry did not fire in cmb-poise.mjs M6; the parry and the 56 f PARRIED state are measured, the riposte off a parry is not.
notes_for_successor: Two instruments are new and worth keeping: tools/harness/anim-tune.mjs measures the swing with no browser in <1 s and reproduces the browser probe to 2 dp, and tools/harness/anim-author.mjs re-authors and re-solves the archetypes against RI-CMB04 §B and RI-CMB02 §A together. Never hand-edit clips.json §archetypes for the four attack archetypes — edit anim-author.mjs and re-run it with --write. Concurrent agents (W1-14 magic, W1-15 stealth) were editing game/src/engine.js and game/data/index.json during this task; index.json must be regenerated with tools/analysis/data-index.mjs, not hand-patched.
